title: add rag agent templates, tool-calling quickstarts, and docs site updates
author: Priya Singh
release_notes: Add RAG agent templates, agents/tool-calling quickstarts (Python + TypeScript), and docs site updates to improve developer onboarding and provide canonical examples for RAG + agent workflows
description: Add RAG agent templates, tool-calling quickstarts, and docs site updates. Motivation: provide first-class quickstarts and canonical examples for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) + agent/tool-calling flows so engineers can onboard faster and run consistent evals. This PR includes: 1) RAG agent templates (JSON/YAML) and playbook examples in redwood-examples/rag-agent-templates; 2) two quickstarts (Python and TypeScript) demonstrating agent setup, tool registration, function/tool calling, and end-to-end RAG flows under redwood-quickstarts/agents/tool-calling; 3) docs site changes (redwood-docs/docs/guides/agents/*) with step-by-step guides, diagrams, and sidebar updates; 4) a small helper in redwood-sdk-python to simplify tool registration in quickstarts; 5) updated README, screenshots, and CI metadata for docs builds. Commits summary: (a) feat: add initial RAG templates and example playbooks; (b) feat: add python quickstart, example dataset and README; (c) feat: add typescript quickstart and examples; (d) docs: update agents guide, add diagrams and sidebar entry; (e) fix: docs frontmatter and linting issues discovered by CI. Changed files (high level):  - redwood-examples/rag-agent-templates/faq-template.json (new)  - redwood-examples/rag-agent-templates/search-agent.yaml (new)  - redwood-quickstarts/agents/tool-calling/python/quickstart.py (new)  - redwood-quickstarts/agents/tool-calling/python/README.md (new)  - redwood-quickstarts/agents/tool-calling/ts/quickstart.ts (new)  - redwood-quickstarts/agents/tool-calling/ts/README.md (new)  - redwood-docs/docs/guides/agents/overview.md (updated)  - redwood-docs/docs/guides/agents/tool-calling.md (new)  - redwood-docs/siteConfig/sidebar.yml (updated)  - redwood-sdk-python/redwood/sdk/tools.py (modified: add helper register_tool_from_spec)  - .github/workflows/docs.yml (tweak: increase timeout)  - docs/images/agents-diagram.png (new). Small illustrative snippet added to python quickstart showing tool decorator usage (3 lines) and TypeScript example showing minimal tool interface (2 lines). CI: initial docs build failed due to missing frontmatter on agents/tool-calling.md, fixed in commit (e). Full CI run: docs-build ✓, python-tests ✓, ts-tests ✓, lint ✓. Review thread: Marco Li: "Can you add a short section about authenticating tool calls for private deployments (VPC/KMS note)?" Author reply: "Added section with example env var names and KMS note, and linked to Private installer guide." Ava Thompson: "Please make env var names consistent across examples (REDWOOD_API_KEY vs RW_API_KEY)." Author reply: "Standardized to REDWOOD_API_KEY across both quickstarts." Diego Ramirez: "LGTM after docs frontmatter fix." Approvals: Marco Li, Ava Thompson. Merge: squash-and-merge on 2025-02-12. Notes: this PR is primarily docs/examples and should not affect runtime behavior; the only runtime-adjacent change is a small client helper which is fully unit-tested. Related work items: ENG-3173 (agent UX initiatives), PM-221 (quickstart rollout). Support request SUP-452 requested clearer examples for customers evaluating tool-calling — included sample playbook. Backcompat: no breaking changes.
notes: Docs + examples: RAG templates, Python & TS quickstarts, docs site updates, small SDK helper. CI green after fix; merged by squash.
